title: Which signed laws reproduce themselves on which gaskets
claim: Among the 1,168 signed three-bit laws (the 34 knots with weights plus or minus one, first allowed tuple +1), exactly 68 are exact on some level-k Sierpinski gasket SG_k with 2 <= k <= 12 (exact computation). 26 lie in families explained for every k: F1, signed not-all-equal and its rotations, every k (SIGNED-GASKETS-20261029-001A with the gasket's symmetries); F2, their relabelings by position parity (x -> x xor (alpha i + beta j)), odd k; F3, (-1)^a [NAE] = -(-1)^(a+b+c) w and its rotations, exact exactly when k = 1, 2 mod 4 and the factor is nonzero (never at k = 0, 3 mod 4, where the corner relation is a cosine form; the factor is nonzero to k = 22, conjectured for all k); F4, the relabelings of F3, k = 1 mod 4; P, unsigned even and odd parity, exactly at powers of 2 with factor 2^(k-1) (Lucas). The other 42 are sporadic: 30 three-excluded laws exact only at k = 3 and 12 not-all-equal laws exact only at k = 5.
failure_conditions: A law exact on SG_k (2 <= k <= 12) outside the stated families and sporadic list, or a member of a family not exact at a level the family predicts.
(-1)^a [NAE] exact at some k = 0 or 3 mod 4, or not proportional to its law at some k = 1 or 2 mod 4.
An unsigned parity law exact at a level that is not a power of 2, or not exact at a power of 2.
foundation_claim_scope: Signed three-bit laws on the level-k Sierpinski gaskets, k = 2 to 12 by exact computation, and the stated families for every k.

validation.status: checked: 1,168 laws; engine against brute force on 40 laws at k = 2, 3; census k = 2 to 12 by exact integers; families built from their definitions match the census exactly; F3 exact exactly at k = 1, 2 mod 4 and cosine form otherwise for k <= 16, factor nonzero to k = 22 by residues; parity exact exactly at powers of 2 for k <= 16; the relabeling lemma on 54 cases; controls fire; no human or external review
